description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableExpressionResolver' that implements the 'ExpressionResolver' interface. It contains logic for resolving expressions, including parsing pipeline stages, handling placeholders, and managing placeholder resolvers. The class is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders' package and includes methods for expression resolution, pipeline creation, and placeholder resolution.

classes.name: ImmutableExpressionResolver
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ExpressionResolver that contains the logic for resolving expressions, including parsing pipeline stages, handling placeholders, and managing placeholder resolvers.

methods.name: resolveAsPipelineElement
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder expression into a PipelineElement, handling pipeline stages and placeholder resolution.

methods.name: findPlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Finds a suitable PlaceholderResolver for a given placeholder in the pipeline.

methods.name: resolveSinglePlaceholder
methods.description: Resolves a single placeholder into a PipelineElement, either normally or in validation mode.

methods.name: getPipelineStagesExpressions
methods.description: Parses the input template string into individual pipeline stage expressions, validating the overall pattern.

methods.name: getFirstExpressionInPipe
methods.description: Retrieves the first expression from the list of pipeline stages.

methods.name: getPipelineFromExpressions
methods.description: Creates a Pipeline object from a list of pipeline stage expressions, skipping a specified number of initial stages.

methods.name: getPlaceholderPrefix
methods.description: Extracts the prefix part of a placeholder, if present.
